name: KSeF
description: Polish market 🇵🇱: e-invoicing via the national KSeF 2.0 API — browse incoming cost invoices and your sales, issue FA(3) invoices without leaving the app, track payments. Includes a one-time history import from Fakturownia.pl (numbers, payment statuses, KSeF ids).
author: Cyber Life community

widgets.title: KSeF Today
widgets.description: Invoices that arrived in KSeF today

agentTools.name: list_companies
agentTools.description: List configured companies (id, name, NIP, KSeF environment, last sync time)

agentTools.name: list_invoices
agentTools.description: List invoices across KSeF and imported Fakturownia history. Filter by company, direction (sale/cost), unpaid, date range or free-text query.

company.description: Company name, id or NIP; optional when only one is configured

query.description: Substring match on number, KSeF number or contractor

agentTools.name: create_invoice
agentTools.description: Create a sales invoice (VAT or proforma) with Fakturownia-style numbering; optionally send it straight to KSeF (send: true).

company.description: Company name, id or NIP; optional when only one is configured

send.description: Send to KSeF immediately after creating

agentTools.name: send_invoice
agentTools.description: Send a locally created draft invoice to KSeF (returns the assigned KSeF number)

agentTools.name: mark_paid
agentTools.description: Mark an invoice as paid (or unpaid with paid: false)

agentTools.name: set_invoice_approval
agentTools.description: Set the Fakturownia acceptance status of a cost invoice (received=Otrzymana, accepted=Zatwierdzona, rejected=Odrzucona); in dual mode the change is pushed to Fakturownia first

agentTools.name: sync
agentTools.description: Fetch new invoices from KSeF (sales and incoming costs) for one or all companies

company.description: Company name, id or NIP; omit for all

agentTools.name: list_bank_transactions
agentTools.description: List imported bank-statement operations. Filter by month (YYYY-MM), date range, free-text query or state: ok (paired with an invoice), warn (categorized fee/tax), bad (unassigned), in (incoming).

query.description: Substring across date, type, description, amount, category, matchedBy

agentTools.name: assign_bank_transaction
agentTools.description: Pair a bank operation with an invoice (invoiceId), give it a non-invoice category, link it with its refund (refundTxId — cancelled charge + incoming refund cancel out, state 'ret'), unassign it, or verify a tentative auto-match (verify: true).

category.description: e.g. opłata bankowa, podatek / ZUS, przewalutowanie; 'NKUP — bez odliczenia' marks an expense with no invoice at all (accountant books it as other costs, no tax deduction)

matchedBy.description: Short note on how the pairing was decided

refundTxId.description: Id of the opposite operation (equal amount, opposite sign) — links the two as a cancelled-charge/refund pair

agentTools.name: import_statement
agentTools.description: Import a bank statement PDF (base64): parses (iPKO Biznes / iPKO history), archives the ORIGINAL PDF in the statement registry, buckets operations into their months, keeps existing assignments, auto-matches new operations against invoices.

agentTools.name: tax_alerts
agentTools.description: Check monthly statements for statutory tax payments (ZUS, PIT-4R advance). Returns per-month status: found (with dates/amounts/period markers like 26M06), MISSING, or expected-missing (user confirmed the gap is fine). Pass month+markRule to record such a decision (expected: false clears it).

company.description: Company name, id or NIP; optional when only one is configured

month.description: YYYY-MM; omit for the last months on record

limit.description: How many recent months when month is omitted

markRule.description: Rule id to mark as expected-missing for the given month

expected.description: false clears a previous expected-missing decision

note.description: Why the gap is expected (stored with the decision)

agentTools.name: add_invoice_file
agentTools.description: Add an invoice document (PDF/PNG/JPEG, base64) to the file archive: dedupes by content hash, converts images to PDF, extracts fields (NIP, dates, amounts, currency, VAT rate) and auto-matches against invoices. Follow up with attach_file to pair or create the invoice record.

agentTools.name: update_invoice
agentTools.description: Patch fields of a local invoice record (number, issueDate, currency, gross, net, vat, sellerName, sellerNip, buyerName, buyerNip). Local only — does not push the change to Fakturownia or KSeF.

agentTools.name: list_clients
agentTools.description: List clients (Fakturownia mirror in dual mode, local book otherwise) with their locally-stored bank account numbers.

query.description: Substring across name, NIP and bank accounts

agentTools.name: update_client
agentTools.description: Update a client: bankAccounts replaces the whole list (used to recognize transfers on bank statements); in dual mode the FIRST account also syncs to the Fakturownia client record (their single bank_account field), and accounts kept in Fakturownia flow back into the local register on every client refresh. Contact/address fields are editable for local clients only — in dual mode edit those in Fakturownia.

bankAccounts.description: Full replacement list of account numbers (NRB/IBAN)

agentTools.name: list_unmatched_files
agentTools.description: List archived invoice files (PDF scans) not yet paired with any invoice record

company.description: Company name, id or NIP; optional when only one is configured

agentTools.name: attach_file
agentTools.description: Pair an archived invoice file with an invoice: pass invoiceId to link to an existing record, or createInvoice {dir, number, issueDate, sellerNip, sellerName, net, vat, gross, currency, paid} to create a new record from the document and link it.

matchedBy.description: Short note on how the pairing was decided

sellerVatId.description: Foreign VAT ID (e.g. IE9692928F) when there is no Polish NIP

sellerAddress2.description: "post-code city, country", e.g. "D04 X2K5 Dublin 4, Ireland"

gross.description: Gross total in the document currency

vatRate.description: 23/8/5/0, or "zw"/"np"/"disabled"; defaults to the rate read from the document

currency.description: Defaults to the currency read from the document

paidDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. the card-charge date from the bank statement

agentTools.name: backfill_fv_pdfs
agentTools.description: Download rendered PDFs from Fakturownia for sales invoices that have no file in the archive yet (dual mode; runs bounded — call repeatedly until remaining is 0). Sync does this automatically for new invoices.

agentTools.name: backup_r2
agentTools.description: Mirror a company's file archive (invoices and original statements) into that company's Cloudflare R2 bucket and refresh the per-file backup manifest. action 'status' only reports the configuration and last run without uploading.

company.description: Company name, id or NIP; optional when only one is configured

agentTools.name: import_fakturownia
agentTools.description: Run the full Fakturownia.pl history import for a company (idempotent, re-runnable)

company.description: Company name, id or NIP; optional when only one is configured
